instruction: Query the OQMD database for Ni-Al binary compounds (element_set=Ni,Al AND ntypes=2) using limit=10. Sort the returned results by delta_e ascending in Python. Save the total count (data_available from API metadata), all returned entries (entry_id/name/composition/delta_e), and the entry with the lowest delta_e as the convex hull minimum (entry_id/name/composition/delta_e/spacegroup/volume) to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_20.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
